summary: InflaRx N.V. filed a 424B5 prospectus supplement for an underwritten public offering of 75,000,000 ordinary shares at $2.00 per share (last sale $1.97, no stated premium). The offering is expected to close on May 7, 2026. Guggenheim Securities is lead book-runner. This is a routine equity capital raise, not a special situation. Proceeds are for general corporate purposes. No special-situation triggers such as acquisitions, divestitures, or strategic review are present.
